mapper.sql: b.bridge_id AS bridgeId, b.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_status AS localOrderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.provider_id AS providerId, p.provider_code AS providerCode, b.sku_mapping_id AS skuMappingId, sm.sku_id AS skuId, b.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId, b.provider_order_no AS providerOrderNo, b.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, b.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, b.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, b.bridge_status AS bridgeStatus, b.provider_order_status AS providerOrderStatus, b.quantity AS quantity, b.unit_price AS unitPrice, b.pay_amount AS payAmount, b.currency_code AS currencyCode, b.create_idempotency_key AS createIdempotencyKey, b.payment_idempotency_key AS paymentIdempotencyKey, b.cancel_idempotency_key AS cancelIdempotencyKey, b.reservation_expire_time AS reservationExpireTime, b.provider_create_time AS providerCreateTime, b.provider_pay_time AS providerPayTime, b.provider_cancel_time AS providerCancelTime, b.last_operation AS lastOperation, b.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, b.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, b.last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage, b.last_error_retryable AS lastErrorRetryable, b.unknown_result_since AS unknownResultSince, b.create_recovery_attempts AS createRecoveryAttempts, b.last_recovery_time AS lastRecoveryTime, b.create_time AS createTime, b.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT p.provider_id AS providerId, p.provider_code AS providerCode, p.provider_status AS providerStatus, pm.mapping_id AS projectMappingId, sem.mapping_id AS sessionMappingId, sm.mapping_id AS skuMappingId, pm.mapping_status AS projectMappingStatus, sem.mapping_status AS sessionMappingStatus, sm.mapping_status AS skuMappingStatus, pm.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, sem.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, sm.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, sm.source_sale_status AS sourceSaleStatus, sm.inventory_mode AS inventoryMode, sm.available_stock_snapshot AS availableStockSnapshot, sm.sale_price AS salePrice, sm.currency_code AS currencyCode FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping sm JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping sem ON sem.mapping_id = sm.session_mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping pm ON pm.mapping_id = sem.project_mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id = sm.provider_id WHERE sm.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY p.priority ASC, sm.mapping_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_order_bridge (order_id, provider_id, sku_mapping_id, provider_project_id, provider_session_id, provider_sku_id, bridge_status, provider_order_status, quantity, unit_price, pay_amount, currency_code, create_idempotency_key, payment_idempotency_key, cancel_idempotency_key, reservation_expire_time, last_operation, last_sync_status, request_snapshot, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{providerId}, #{skuMappingId}, #{providerProjectId}, #{providerSessionId}, #{providerSkuId}, 'INITIATING', 'UNKNOWN', #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{payAmount}, #{currencyCode}, #{createIdempotencyKey}, #{paymentIdempotencyKey}, #{cancelIdempotencyKey}, #{reservationExpireTime}, 'CREATE_ORDER', 'PENDING', #{requestSnapshot}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = b.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id = b.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sm ON sm.mapping_id = b.sku_mapping_id WHERE b.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = b.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id = b.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sm ON sm.mapping_id = b.sku_mapping_id WHERE b.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = b.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id = b.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sm ON sm.mapping_id = b.sku_mapping_id WHERE o.order_status = 'WAIT_PAY' AND o.payment_status = 'UNPAID' AND b.bridge_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING') AND COALESCE(b.reservation_expire_time, o.pay_expire_time) <= NOW() ORDER BY COALESCE(b.reservation_expire_time, o.pay_expire_time) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET provider_order_id = #{providerOrderId}, provider_order_no = #{providerOrderNo}, bridge_status = 'RESERVED', provider_order_status = #{providerOrderStatus}, reservation_expire_time = #{reservationExpireTime}, provider_create_time = #{providerCreateTime}, last_operation = 'CREATE_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'SUCCESS', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, last_error_retryable = 0, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('INITIATING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'FAILED', last_operation = 'CREATE_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_error_retryable = #{retryable}, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status = 'INITIATING'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', last_operation = 'CREATE_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_error_retryable = #{retryable}, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status = 'INITIATING'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET provider_order_id = #{providerOrderId}, provider_order_no = #{providerOrderNo}, bridge_status = 'FAILED', provider_order_status = #{providerOrderStatus}, provider_cancel_time = #{providerCancelTime}, last_operation = 'CANCEL_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'SUCCESS', last_error_code = 'LOCAL_FINALIZE_FAILED_COMPENSATED', last_error_message = '第三方预占已成功释放，本地订单已取消', last_error_retryable = 0, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('INITIATING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET provider_order_id = COALESCE(provider_order_id, #{providerOrderId}), provider_order_no = COALESCE(provider_order_no, #{providerOrderNo}), bridge_status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', provider_order_status = COALESCE(#{providerOrderStatus}, provider_order_status), last_operation = 'CANCEL_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_error_retryable = #{retryable}, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('INITIATING', 'FAILED', 'RESERVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING', 'CANCELING', 'MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING', last_operation = 'CONFIRM_PAYMENT', last_sync_status = 'PENDING', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, last_error_retryable = 0, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'RESERVED', last_operation = 'CONFIRM_PAYMENT', last_sync_status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_error_retryable = #{retryable}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status = 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'PAID', provider_order_status = #{providerOrderStatus}, provider_pay_time = #{providerPayTime}, last_operation = 'CONFIRM_PAYMENT', last_sync_status = 'SUCCESS', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, last_error_retryable = 0, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING', 'PAID')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'CANCELING', last_operation = 'CANCEL_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'PENDING', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, last_error_retryable = 0, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING', 'CANCELING', 'MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = 'RESERVED', last_operation = 'CANCEL_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_error_retryable = #{retryable}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status = 'CANCELING'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status = #{bridgeStatus}, provider_order_status = #{providerOrderStatus}, provider_cancel_time = #{providerCancelTime}, last_operation = 'CANCEL_ORDER', last_sync_status = 'SUCCESS', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, last_error_retryable = 0, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMING', 'CANCELING', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED')

UPDATE ticket_order SET order_status = 'CANCELED', cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, update_time = #{cancelTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'WAIT_PAY' AND fulfillment_mode = 'TICKET_SOURCE'
UPDATE ticket_order SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

UPDATE ticket_source_sku_mapping sm JOIN ticket_sku sku ON sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id SET sm.available_stock_snapshot = #{remainingStock}, sm.source_data_version = COALESCE(#{dataVersion}, sm.source_data_version), sm.last_sync_status = 'SUCCESS', sm.last_inventory_sync_time = NOW(), sm.last_error_code = NULL, sm.last_error_message = NULL, sm.update_time = NOW(), sku.stock_available = #{remainingStock}, sku.version = sku.version + 1, sku.update_time = NOW() WHERE sm.provider_id = #{providerId} AND sm.mapping_id = #{skuMappingId} AND sm.sku_id = #{skuId} AND #{remainingStock} IS NOT NULL
